text: This candidate received an overall fit score of 0.1862 for the Senior Full Stack Software Developer position. The strongest evidence of their qualifications is their experience where they "Built REST APIs," alongside listed experience with React and Git. Significant gaps exist, including missing must-have requirements for nodejs, ruby, sql, docker, ci/cd, and cloud computing, as well as a total of 2.54 years of experience. Despite the low fit and missing must-have skills, this application has been escalated for further review.
